note: Extracted from docs/DECISIONS.md §2 and the pipeline diagram at docs/ATLAS.md §17. The tool register (records/tools.json) covers seven pipeline steps; this covers nine, and the two it adds — the safety gate and synthesis — had no surface anywhere.

stages.name: Acquisition
stages.plain: Fetch it, and be allowed to
stages.does: CC crawls, HF datasets, AIKosh/ULCA, eCourts, PIB, licensed publisher feeds, speech corpora, PDF and print scans.
stages.rule: robots.txt, noai and TDM-reservation honoured at fetch time — not retrospectively.

stages.name: Extraction
stages.plain: Get the words off the page
stages.does: HTML to text (trafilatura, resiliparse), PDF and scans through OCR, speech through ASR, image-text interleaving.
stages.rule: Everyone assumes this is solved. It is solved for English layout.

stages.name: Language and script identification
stages.plain: Work out what language it is in
stages.does: GlotLID script-aware ensemble across all twelve script blocks plus Latin, with code-mix and romanisation detection.
stages.rule: Hinglish is a first-class language here, not noise. Misrouting is invisible — a document sent to the wrong pipeline is simply never seen again.

stages.name: Quality filtering
stages.does: Per-language heuristics, KenLM perplexity against a verified reference, a model-based classifier trained per language, repetition and length checks.
stages.rule: The classifier is the adversary here, not the tool. See the objective-specific rules below.

stages.name: Safety and compliance gate
stages.plain: Remove what must never be trained on
stages.does: PII redaction with Aadhaar, PAN, passport and bank pattern detection; CSAM hash matching on all image data; multilingual toxicity classification; children's-data exclusion; licence-tag propagation; a provenance record carrying URL, licence, hash and retrieval date.
stages.rule: No tool in the register covers this stage. It is the one stage where a miss is not a quality problem but a legal and ethical one — and it is the only stage that has to be built rather than adopted.

stages.name: Deduplication
stages.does: Exact SHA, then global MinHash and LSH across corpora, then embedding-based SemDeDup on the top-quality tier.
stages.rule: This is the step that determines your real token count. Everything quoted before it is a claim about file size.

stages.name: Benchmark decontamination
stages.plain: Make sure the exam is not in the textbook
stages.does: 13-gram overlap plus MinHash against the benchmark blocklist. Every drop logged with the benchmark it matched.
stages.rule: A build gate, not a check — see how we would know it worked.

stages.name: Synthesis
stages.plain: Make more text when there is not enough
stages.does: Translation, transliteration, rephrasing, curriculum generation across 22 languages and five difficulty tiers, document-grounded and persona-grounded generation.
stages.rule: Synthetic text re-enters the quality, dedup and decontamination gates. It is not exempt because you made it.

stages.name: Mixing and tokenisation
stages.plain: Decide the proportions and cut it into tokens
stages.does: Custom tokenizer, temperature-sampled multilingual mixture, phase-scheduled curriculum.
stages.rule: The last stage in the pipeline and the first decision you cannot reverse.

universal.order: NFC and homoglyph normalisation, script-aware language ID, India-specific PII, global MinHash and SemDeDup, 13-gram benchmark decontamination, provenance record

objective_rules.rule: Quality classifiers are the adversary. Per-language calibrated thresholds, never a global one. Tier-3 languages bypass filtering entirely into the protected lane.
objective_rules.counterintuitive: The fix is not a better classifier. It is refusing to let the classifier vote.

objective_rules.rule: Do not length-filter like prose. Licence allowlist plus a live opt-out list. Function-level near-dedup.
objective_rules.counterintuitive: Prose heuristics delete correct code for being terse.

objective_rules.rule: Filter suboptimal trajectories hard. Errors amplify over long horizons — a mediocre 80-turn trace is worse than none.
objective_rules.counterintuitive: This inverts "more data is better". It is the only tier where deleting data reliably improves the model.

objective_rules.rule: Preserve LaTeX. Do not normalise digits.
objective_rules.counterintuitive: Standard text cleaning destroys the notation that carries the meaning.

objective_rules.rule: Temporal validity. Law changes — date-stamp everything.
objective_rules.counterintuitive: Undated statute trains as current fact, and stays wrong for the life of the model.

objective_rules.rule: Build on Qwen3-VL-8B, not olmOCR. Validate on real scans only. Report median and catastrophic-rate, never mean.
objective_rules.counterintuitive: A mean hides the failure mode that matters: rare, total, unrecoverable garbling.

curriculum.why: The order matters as much as the mixture. Rare-script embeddings form early or not at all.

phases.name: Foundations
phases.emphasis: Broad web, heavy multilingual, Indic scripts front-loaded

phases.name: Reasoning
phases.emphasis: Maths, long chains, synthetic QA, curriculum-graded Indic

phases.name: Anneal
phases.emphasis: Highest quality only, learning rate to zero. This is where benchmark performance is bought.

zero_trust.rule: Every dataset passes the full pipeline, including the ones labelled verified.
zero_trust.why: A label is a claim its publisher made, not a measurement you performed. The clearest case in this catalogue is Sangraha, which is the best-documented Indic corpus anybody has built and still ships 251B tokens of which 64B are verified human-origin: roughly 90B is machine-translated from Wikimedia and 72B is romanised transliteration. Nothing is wrong with that — the publisher says so plainly — but a plan that budgets the headline has silently counted machine translation as human text.
zero_trust.consequence: Trust is not transitive and it does not survive a merge. Once corpora are combined, cleaned, shuffled and sharded, a per-document record of what was verified and what was manufactured cannot be reconstructed — so it has to be carried from the first fetch or it does not exist.
zero_trust.source: docs/ATLAS.md and the Sangraha dataset card

provenance.note: The only numbers here are the curriculum phase boundaries, which are a schedule rather than a measurement.
